description: Main source code for the Flutter frontend of a dating app, including theme setup, filter data models, and UI for filter page.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget that sets the Ocean Professional theme and home page.

classes.name: FilterPreferences
classes.description: DTO for filter options, includes method to build URL query parameters.

classes.name: HairColor
classes.description: Enumeration of hair color options for filtering.

classes.name: FiltersPage
classes.description: Main page widget for displaying and modifying filter options.

methods.name: _oceanProScheme
methods.description: Generates a ColorScheme based on the Ocean Professional palette and brightness.

methods.name: _theme
methods.description: Creates ThemeData using the custom color scheme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main MaterialApp widget with theme and home page.

methods.name: toQueryParams
methods.description: Builds URL query parameters from filter preferences.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of FilterPreferences with optional new values.
